title: Sketchpad Platform Refactor
description: Rename ProductRuntime to Platform; replace board/scene3d with table/puzzle2d/puzzle3d/puzzle5d/cad/panel component kinds; rewrite sketchpad as declarative Platform instance with home/kit table + kit diagram slice.
summary: Renamed ProductRuntime→Platform and ProductDefinition→PlatformDefinition in @framework/platform/core; added ComponentKind vocabulary (table, puzzle2d, puzzle3d, puzzle5d, cad, panel) and window-body builders; PlatformSpec constructor on Platform. React renderer: PlatformView (platform prop), registerSurfaceBinding seam, UiRenderer dispatches by component kind. Sketchpad: buildSketchpadPlatform/ensureSketchpadPlatform, declarative window bodies for all apps, surface bindings for home table (table), kit table (table), kit diagram (puzzle2d), design (puzzle5d), type (cad), docs/feedback (panel). Updated playground core aliases, play sites, cad play, desktop (dropped missing qualityConfig). Framework vitest: 9 core + 8 renderer tests passing.
